CULTURAL HERITAGE COMMISSION AGENDA
  TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 24, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

Kevin McGuan, Vice Chair  Jacqueline Padilla-Perez, Commissioner
Amy Bodek, Commissioner  Marco Pizzo, Commissioner
Mark Grisafe, Commissioner  Jocelynn Pryor, Commissioner
Tasha Hunter, Commissioner

  CULTURAL HERITAGE COMMISSION IN-PERSON MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT EMAIL COMMENTS
  TO CULTURAL.HERITAGE@LONGBEACH.GOV

  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION OR BY PRESSING *9 ON YOUR PHONE

  PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 954 4193 2207
  http://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/95441932207

 PLEASE NOTE THE ZOOM MEETING MAY ENCOUNTER TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS, BUT IN-
  PERSON ACCESS AND PUBLIC COMMENT WILL CONTINUE TO BE AVAILABLE IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE BROWN ACT

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-54949  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-54950  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Cultural Heritage Commission
  meeting of Tuesday, July 30, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-54292  Recommendation to make an appointment to the Long Beach Navy Memorial
  Heritage Trust (Navy Trust) Board of Trustees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 2
   CULTURAL HERITAGE COMMISSION AGENDA
  TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 24, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

4.  24-54951  Recommendation to approve a Certificate of Appropriateness and adopt the
  proposed findings and conditions of approval thereto, to allow a 105-square-foot
  addition to the side of an existing single-family residence, visible from the public
  right-of-way. The property, a historically contributing structure within Rose Park, is
  located at 792 Gladys Avenue in the R-2-N Zone. (District 2)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-54952  Recommendation to receive and file a training regarding certificates of
  appropriateness, including the duties and role of Cultural Heritage Commissioners,
  understanding the historic resource, project evaluation, and making findings related
  thereto.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Cultural Heritage Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online
at https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, or if you need the agenda provided in an alternate format, please call the Office
of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 by 12 noon, the day prior to the meeting.

Mark Grisafe, Commissioner  Jocelynn Pryor, Commissioner
Tasha Hunter, Commissioner

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 5:03 PM, Vice Chair McGuan called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Bodek, Grisafe, Padilla-Perez, Pizzo, Pryor, McGuan

Commissioners Absent: Hunter

Also present: Erin Weesner-McKinley, Deputy City Attorney, Alejandro Sanchez-Lopez, Advanced
Planning Officer, Alejandro Plascencia, Planner, Felice Anaya, Clerk Typist, Vanessa Hall, City
Clerk Specialist.

Vice Chair McGuan spoke; and announced that Commissioner Hunter was excused from the
meeting.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Commissioner Grisafe led the Pledge of Allegiance.

  A motion was made by Vice Chair McGuan, seconded by Commissioner

  Yes:  6  Bodek, Grisafe, Padilla-Perez, Pizzo, Pryor, McGuan
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None

  spoke.
